sec=manual.split("## 8. 唯一正式模块路线图 M00–M15\n",1)[1].split("## 9.",1)[0]
rows=[[v.strip() for v in line.strip("|").split("|")] for line in sec.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\| M\d{2} ",line)]

pids=re.findall(r"^\| (M\d{2}) ",psec,re.M)

edges={row[0]:re.findall(r"M\d{2}",row[2]) for row in rows}
active=set(); done=set(); order=[]
def visit(n):
 assert n not in active, "Dependency cycle"
 if n in done:return
